posts.title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
posts.synopsis: A delirious Spanish conquistador leads a doomed expedition down the Amazon in search of El Dorado, his sanity dissolving with every mile of jungle.
pluses: Klaus Kinski at his most unhinged

posts.title: Come and See
posts.synopsis: A boy joins the partisans in occupied Belarus and is dragged through the atrocities of war until his face is no longer that of a child.

posts.title: Perfect Blue
posts.synopsis: A retired pop idol turned actress loses her grip on reality as a stalker and her own fracturing identity blur the line between self and image.

posts.title: Sans Soleil
posts.synopsis: A globe-spanning essay film stitched from letters, memory and footage of Japan and Guinea-Bissau, meditating on time and the images we keep.

posts.title: Stalker
posts.synopsis: A guide leads a writer and a scientist through the Zone, a forbidden landscape where a room is said to grant your deepest wish.

posts.title: Grave of the Fireflies
posts.synopsis: Two siblings struggle to survive in the final months of WWII Japan after firebombing leaves them orphaned and alone.

posts.title: The Act of Killing
posts.synopsis: Perpetrators of the Indonesian genocide re-enact their killings as movie scenes, exposing a chilling gap between memory and conscience.

posts.title: Tampopo
posts.synopsis: A trucker helps a widow perfect her ramen shop in a playful ode to food, desire and the rituals of eating.

posts.title: Paprika
posts.synopsis: A stolen device lets a therapist enter patients dreams, until the dream world starts leaking catastrophically into waking life.

posts.title: Koyaanisqatsi
posts.synopsis: A wordless montage of nature and industry, scored by Philip Glass, arguing that modern life is out of balance.

posts.title: Woman in the Dunes
posts.synopsis: An entomologist is trapped in a sand pit with a lone woman, forced to shovel back the dunes that threaten to bury them both.

posts.title: Angel's Egg
posts.synopsis: In a drowned gothic world a silent girl guards a mysterious egg, in a near-wordless meditation on faith and loss.
